pairs.target: luó dí lái lǐng gōngqián shí , tǎ wéi cái zhīdào tā míngrì bù gēn tāmen chūmén .
pairs.english: Only when Luodi came to collect his pay did Tavi learn he would not be going out with them tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻来领工钱时，塔维才知道他明日不跟他们出门。

pairs.target: tā zhèng dūn zài kèzhàn yuànlǐ , bǎ zuórì jiè de duǎn mù shàng nián de ní guādiào .
pairs.english: He was crouching in the inn courtyard, scraping mud off the short timbers borrowed yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 他正蹲在客栈院里，把昨日借的短木上粘的泥刮掉。

pairs.target: tīngjiàn ruǎn héng shù qián , tā táitóu wèn luó dí , shìbushì míngtiān gǎi qù cāng hòu nà yíduàn .
pairs.english: Hearing Ruan Heng count out money, he looked up and asked Luodi whether tomorrow's destination had changed to the stretch behind the warehouses.
pairs.hanzi: 听见阮衡数钱，他抬头问罗荻，是不是明天改去仓后那一段。

pairs.target: luó dí jiāng qián wǎng nèi dài lǐ yì sāi , shuō zìjǐ yuánxiān jiù zhī yìng le zhè jǐtiān , míngtiān tì tángxiōng xiū wūhòu de tīzǐ , hòu rì hái yuē le biérén xiū chēzhóu .
pairs.english: Luodi stuffed the money in his inner pocket and said he had only agreed to these few days originally. Tomorrow he was repairing the ladder behind his cousin's house, and the day after he had another cart-axle repair booked.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻将钱往内袋里一塞，说自己原先就只应了这几天，明天替堂兄修屋后的梯子，后日还约了别人修车轴。

pairs.target: " nǐ búshì yìzhí zài zhèlǐ bāng wǒmen ? "
pairs.english: “Haven't you been helping us here all along?”
pairs.hanzi: “你不是一直在这里帮我们？”

pairs.target: " wǒ yìzhí zhù zhèlǐ . " luó dí shuō , " bāng nǐmen yě shì huó . nǐmen méi yuē wǒ xiàgèyuè , wǒ yě dé chī xiàgèyuè de fàn . "
pairs.english: “I've lived here all along,” Luodi said. “Helping you is work too. You haven't booked me for next month, and I'll still need to eat next month.”
pairs.hanzi: “我一直住这里。”罗荻说，“帮你们也是活。你们没约我下个月，我也得吃下个月的饭。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi liǎnshàng yǒuxiē rè .
pairs.english: Tavi's face grew a little hot.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维脸上有些热。

pairs.target: búshì tā yǐwéi luó dí bùgāi ná qián ; tā zhǐshì kàn tā měitiān láide shú , lián zhǎngguìde jī dōu duǒ zhe tā zǒu , biàn bùzhībùjué jiāng tā suàn jìn ruǎn héng dàilái de rén lǐ .
pairs.english: It was not that he thought Luodi should not be paid. He had simply seen how familiar Luodi was each day, even the innkeeper's chickens dodging him, and unconsciously counted him among the people Ruan Heng had brought along.
pairs.hanzi: 不是他以为罗荻不该拿钱；他只是看他每天来得熟，连掌柜的鸡都躲着他走，便不知不觉将他算进阮衡带来的人里。

pairs.target: " tīzǐ xiū wán hái bǐ bu bǐ ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Will we compete again after the ladder's fixed?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “梯子修完还比不比？”他问。

pairs.target: luó dí jiāng yìméi qián cóng pò le xiàn de dài jiǎo lāo huílái : " bǐ . kěbú tì nǐ xiě bàogào , bié xiǎng ná yíkuài táng gù wǒ . "
pairs.english: Luodi retrieved a coin from the pocket corner with the broken stitching. “Yes. But I won't write your report. Don't think you can hire me for one sweet.”
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻将一枚钱从破了线的袋角捞回来：“比。可不替你写报告，别想拿一块糖雇我。”

pairs.target: shàngwǔ de bàogào háishì dé tāmen zìjǐ xiě .
pairs.english: They still had to write the morning's report themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 上午的报告还是得他们自己写。

pairs.target: yù hé zài fánglǐ hésuàn jìlù , ruǎn héng yào qù zhǎo shū yàn héduì míngrì de ānpái , ràng tǎ wéi dàishàng zuórì de báobǎn , yìqǐ zài zǒuyíbiàn zhuǎnwānchù .
pairs.english: Yuhe totaled the records in their room. Ruan Heng was going to check tomorrow's arrangements with Shuyan and asked Tavi to bring yesterday's thin board and walk the bend with him again.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾在房里合算记录，阮衡要去找舒砚核对明日的安排，让塔维带上昨日的薄板，一起再走一遍转弯处。

pairs.target: jiēkǒu yǐyǒu jǐliàngchē , cháng xiāng chē bú zài .
pairs.english: There were already a few carts at the street entrance, but the long-crate cart was absent.
pairs.hanzi: 街口已有几辆车，长箱车不在。

pairs.target: mài suān guǒ de lǎorén zhèng bǎ lǒu fàng shàng xiǎotuīchē , kànjiàn tǎ wéi , xiān wèn jīnrì hái shù bu shù tā .
pairs.english: The elderly sour-fruit seller was putting baskets on his little handcart. Seeing Tavi, he first asked whether he would be counted again today.
pairs.hanzi: 卖酸果的老人正把篓放上小推车，看见塔维，先问今日还数不数他。

pairs.target: tā zuórì guò le sānhuí , huíjiā bèi érxí shuō zhǐjiàn tā wǎng wài pǎo , bújiàn tā duō màidōngxī .
pairs.english: He had passed three times yesterday, and at home his daughter-in-law said she only saw him running out, never selling more goods.
pairs.hanzi: 他昨日过了三回，回家被儿媳说只见他往外跑，不见他多卖东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō jīnrì bú shù , yòu wèn tā yìbān shénme shíhòu shōutān .
pairs.english: Tavi said he was not counting today and asked when the old man usually packed up his stall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说今日不数，又问他一般什么时候收摊。

pairs.target: lǎorén shuō zìjǐ guòwǔ jiù zǒu , dàn shōu dé wǎn de yào děng mǎicài de rén sàn , méi gè zhǔndiǎn .
pairs.english: The old man said he left after noon, but those packing up later waited for the vegetable shoppers to disperse; there was no fixed time.
pairs.hanzi: 老人说自己过午就走，但收得晚的要等买菜的人散，没个准点。

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhǐ lín tān , nàlǐ liǎngzhāng bù hái gài zhe kōng lǒu , màizhǔ qù chīfàn le .
pairs.english: He pointed to the neighboring stall, where two cloths still covered empty baskets; the seller had gone to eat.
pairs.hanzi: 他指指邻摊，那里两张布还盖着空篓，卖主去吃饭了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng yuánběn xiǎng hǎo dehuà yàn le huíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi swallowed what he had originally planned to say.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将原本想好的话咽了回去。

pairs.target: tā běnlái yǐwéi wǔfàn shí téngchū yíduàn gěi cháng chē , xīngxǔ shuí yě bù dānwù , kě tānzi méi chè , rén jiù hái dé huílái .
pairs.english: He had thought that reserving a stretch for long carts at lunchtime might delay nobody, but if the stalls remained, people still had to return.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来以为午饭时腾出一段给长车，兴许谁也不耽误，可摊子没撤，人就还得回来。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méi cuī tā , zhàn zài pángbiān děng lǎorén jiāng tuīchē bǎng hǎo , yòu wèn le bàngwǎn xià shì shí yǒu duōshǎo huò yào wǎng wàiyùn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng did not hurry him. He stood beside them until the old man had secured the handcart, then asked how much freight went out when the market closed in the evening.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没催他，站在旁边等老人将推车绑好，又问了傍晚下市时有多少货要往外运。

pairs.target: děng liǎng rén zǒu dào shíjiē biān , tǎ wéi cái bǎ zìjǐ de zhǔyì shuō le , yě shuō le wèn dào yíbàn fāxiàn de bùtuǒ .
pairs.english: Only when they reached the stone steps did Tavi explain his idea, along with the problem he had discovered halfway through asking.
pairs.hanzi: 等两人走到石阶边，塔维才把自己的主意说了，也说了问到一半发现的不妥。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng ràng tā zhàoyàngxiě , xiě qīng hái quē nǎ yíduàn jìlù , biétì méi wèn guò de tānzhǔ dāying rànglù .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng told him to write it anyway, specifying which period's records were still missing, without promising access on behalf of stallholders he had not asked.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡让他照样写，写清还缺哪一段记录，别替没问过的摊主答应让路。

pairs.target: huíqù hòu , tǎ wéi jiāng wǔjiān ràng chē de bànfǎ liè zài yìjiǎo , zài pángbiān liú le kònggé .
pairs.english: Back at the inn, Tavi listed the midday cart-access proposal in one corner, leaving empty boxes beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 回去后，塔维将午间让车的办法列在一角，在旁边留了空格。

pairs.target: tā lìngwài huà le zǎoshàng nuó kōng kuāng de wèizhì , biāochū tíng dǎng fàngzài nǎlǐ , nǎxiē rén xiān zhàn jìn pù yán , chē cái tuì dé chūlái .
pairs.english: He also drew the places where they had moved the empty baskets that morning, marking where the stops went and who had first stood under the shop eaves so the cart could reverse out.
pairs.hanzi: 他另外画了早上挪空筐的位置，标出停挡放在哪里，哪些人先站进铺檐，车才退得出来。

pairs.target: zhè yíduàn búyòng cāi , tā zìjǐ nuó guò , xiùkǒu shàng xiànzài háiyǒu kuāng biān gōuqǐ de xiàntóu .
pairs.english: This part required no guessing; he had moved them himself, and a thread snagged by a basket edge still stuck out of his cuff.
pairs.hanzi: 这一段不用猜，他自己挪过，袖口上现在还有筐边勾起的线头。

pairs.target: yù hé kànguò tú , tíbǐ gǎi le tíng dǎng lí hòulún de jùlí .
pairs.english: Yuhe examined the diagram and picked up her pen to correct the distance between the stops and the rear wheel.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾看过图，提笔改了停挡离后轮的距离。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yí lèng , qǔchū báobǎn héduì , fāxiànzìjǐ jiāng lìng yíliàngchē de shù chāo jìnlái le .
pairs.english: Tavi paused, took out the thin board to check, and found he had copied in the figures for a different cart.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一愣，取出薄板核对，发现自己将另一辆车的数抄进来了。

pairs.target: tā chóngxīn xiě hǎo , cái bǎ tú jiāogěi ruǎn héng .
pairs.english: He rewrote it before handing the diagram to Ruan Heng.
pairs.hanzi: 他重新写好，才把图交给阮衡。

pairs.target: bàogào lǐ méi bǎ shàngcéng huò lù xiěchéng yǐjīng néng kāi .
pairs.english: The report did not describe the upper freight route as ready to reopen.
pairs.hanzi: 报告里没把上层货路写成已经能开。

pairs.target: zǎoshàng nà fēng liánmíng qǐngqiú lìngfù yíyè , tōngxíng jìlù , cháng xiāng bānyùn de nánchù , dāngdìrén yào liú de shíjiē kǒu , gè yǒu zìjǐ de wèizhì .
pairs.english: The morning's joint request was attached on a separate page. The passage records, difficulties moving the long crates, and the stone-step entrance locals wanted preserved each had their place.
pairs.hanzi: 早上那封联名请求另附一页，通行记录、长箱搬运的难处、当地人要留的石阶口，各有自己的位置。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng tāmen hái méi zuò de jiǎnchá quān chū , qiān le zìjǐ de míng , yù hé yě zài cè jì yè shàng qiānmíng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng circled the inspections they had not yet done and signed his name; Yuhe also signed the measurement page.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将他们还没做的检查圈出，签了自己的名，郁禾也在测记页上签名。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài xiézhù jìlù yìlán xiěxià míngzì , zì bǐ píngcháng màn le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi wrote his name in the recording-assistance column, writing a little more slowly than usual.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在协助记录一栏写下名字，字比平常慢了一点。

pairs.target: shū yàn wǔhòu lái qǔ , dú dào jiè mù qīngchǎng nàlǐ , wèn zhè shì shuí bāng zhe gān de .
pairs.english: Shuyan came to collect it in the afternoon. Reading about the borrowed timbers and clearing the space, she asked who had helped with that.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚午后来取，读到借木清场那里，问这是谁帮着干的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō luó dí yě zài , gǎnjǐn bǔ shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi said Luodi had been there too and hurried to add his name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说罗荻也在，赶紧补上。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn tā de bǐjì , xiào le yíxià , shuō luó dí wǎnshàng duōbànhuì ná zhè shì gēn tángxiōng chuī .
pairs.english: She saw his handwriting, smiled, and said Luodi would probably boast to his cousin about this tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见他的笔迹，笑了一下，说罗荻晚上多半会拿这事跟堂兄吹。

pairs.target: yìchē dàilái de xìn jiù zài zhèshí sòngdào , zhǎngguì zài lóuxià jiào le liǎnghuí tǎ wéi cái tīngjiàn .
pairs.english: Letters brought by the post cart arrived just then; the innkeeper called twice downstairs before Tavi heard.
pairs.hanzi: 驿车带来的信就在这时送到，掌柜在楼下叫了两回塔维才听见。

pairs.target: tā pǎoxiàqù , jiēdào mǐlā hé yīwén gè yìfēng .
pairs.english: He ran down and received a letter each from Mira and Iven.
pairs.hanzi: 他跑下去，接到米拉和伊文各一封。

pairs.target: rìqī dōu bǐ tā hébiān xiě de nàwǎn zǎo , búshì huíxìn , shì liǎngtóu de xìn zài lùshang cuòguò le .
pairs.english: Both dates were earlier than the night he wrote by the river. These were not replies: their letters had crossed on the road.
pairs.hanzi: 日期都比他河边写的那晚早，不是回信，是两头的信在路上错过了。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō qiáo zuò shè de dìyījiān gōngpéng bǐ xuégōng ǎi , zìjǐ dìyītiān tái zhe yàngjiàn zhuǎnshēn , pèngfān le guà zài ménbiān de jiù màozi .
pairs.english: Mira said the cooperative's first workshop was lower than the academy's; turning with her prototype on the first day, she knocked down an old hat hanging beside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说桥作社的第一间工棚比学宫矮，自己第一天抬着样件转身，碰翻了挂在门边的旧帽子。

pairs.target: gǔ jì xiào dé zhí bù qǐ yāo , suíhòu jiào tā xiān bǎ màozi xǐ le zài tán xīn zhījià .
pairs.english: Guji doubled over laughing, then told her to wash the hat before discussing the new support frame.
pairs.hanzi: 谷霁笑得直不起腰，随后叫她先把帽子洗了再谈新支架。

pairs.target: tā hé sū yǐ de jìlù yǐjīng shōu hǎo , zìjǐ de bànrì shì zuò hái méiyòng shàng , guāng xiǎng xiān zuò shénme biàn zhēng diào le bàn fēngxìn zhǐ .
pairs.english: Her records with Suyi were safely kept. She had not used her half-day prototype session yet; just arguing about what to make first had consumed half the letter paper.
pairs.hanzi: 她和苏苡的记录已经收好，自己的半日试做还没用上，光想先做什么便争掉了半封信纸。

pairs.target: mòwěi huà le yìdǐng bǐ gōngpéng hái dà de màozi .
pairs.english: At the end she had drawn a hat even bigger than the workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 末尾画了一顶比工棚还大的帽子。

pairs.target: yīwén de zì jǐ dé mì , xiě shī nán dài tā kàn jiāojiē shí , liǎngbiān shuō de dōu shì " zàncún ", yìbiān dàngzuò zhī fàng yíyè , lìngyìbiān què yǐwéi yào tìrén kàn mǎn qītiān .
pairs.english: Iven's writing was tightly packed. He wrote that when Shinan took him to observe a handover, both sides said “temporary storage”: one meant a single night, while the other thought they must look after the goods for seven full days.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的字挤得密，写施南带他看交接时，两边说的都是“暂存”，一边当作只放一夜，另一边却以为要替人看满七天。

pairs.target: tā hái méi pèngdào shénme jīmì , dǎo xiān tì liǎnggè rén bǎ huà zhòng shuō le sānbiàn .
pairs.english: He had not encountered any secrets yet, but had already restated what two people meant three times for them.
pairs.hanzi: 他还没碰到什么机密，倒先替两个人把话重说了三遍。

pairs.target: tā zài xìn wěi wèn zhé tóng néng bunéng mǎi dào bù yǎo shétou de suān guǒ , yuànyì ná tóng jiē chéng de diǎnxīn huàn .
pairs.english: At the letter's end he asked whether Zhetong sold sour fruit that did not bite the tongue, offering Copperstep City pastries in exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 他在信尾问折桐能不能买到不咬舌头的酸果，愿意拿铜阶城的点心换。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng liǎngfēngxìn tānkāi , dúwán yòu dú , shēnshǒu qù ná zhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi spread both letters out, read them again after finishing, and reached for paper.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将两封信摊开，读完又读，伸手去拿纸。

pairs.target: lóuxià luó dí yǐjīng zài hǎn , shuō xiū tīzǐ de yuēdìng shì míngrì , jīnrì bàngwǎn tā hái kōng zhe , zài wǎnxiē hǎo shéng jiù quán bèi tángxiōng shōu le .
pairs.english: Downstairs Luodi was already shouting that the ladder repair was booked for tomorrow. He was free this evening, and any later his cousin would have put all the good rope away.
pairs.hanzi: 楼下罗荻已经在喊，说修梯子的约定是明日，今日傍晚他还空着，再晚些好绳就全被堂兄收了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ yā zài xìn xià , dàishàng zuótiān shèng de bànkuài táng pǎo xiàlóu .
pairs.english: Tavi tucked the paper under the letters and ran downstairs with the half sweet left from yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸压在信下，带上昨天剩的半块糖跑下楼。

pairs.target: dìyījù huà xiān wèn : " nǐ zhèhuí yòu dài zìjǐ de shéng le méiyǒu ? "
pairs.english: His first words were, “Have you brought your own rope again this time?”
pairs.hanzi: 第一句话先问：“你这回又带自己的绳了没有？”
